title: DEPHYRIER Pandrah Bhasha (Fifteen Tongues One Doctrine)
style: polyglot pulse 96 bpm trilingual EN HI FR DEPHYRIER signature fifteen-language-rotation doctrine-not-decoration warm-pad spoken-hindi ledger-tone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Fifteen languages in rotation through the chorus chain
English anchor every track the spine that holds the frame
Latin Spanish French Italian carry the doctrine load
Maori Mandarin Arabic Hindi widen the road

[Pre-Chorus — Hindi romanization]
Pandrah bhasha chakra mein ghoomti
(Fifteen languages spinning in the cycle)
Angrezi reedh har gaane ki dhaakti
(English the spine of every song asserting)

[Chorus — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER fifteen tongues one doctrine song
Pandrah bhasha ek lay long
(Fifteen languages one rhythm long)
Quinze langues une doctrine longue
(Fifteen languages one long doctrine)

[Verse 2]
Indonesian Portuguese German Russian Korean too
Japanese Te Reo and the trilingual code-switch breaks through
No language is decoration each carries a phrase
The doctrine is the message the language is the maze

[Bridge — French]
Quinze langues pas pour la performance
(Fifteen languages not for performance)
Chaque mot porte la doctrine en avance
(Each word carries the doctrine forward)

[Outro — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER fifteen tongues one truth
Pandrah bhasha doctrina larga
DEPHYRIER quinze langues une voie
